top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks (Katori and Ye) pass my instrument test: the magic-wavelength lattice is a decisive physical idea, performance near 1e-18 is reproduced and intercompared by independent laboratories, and the two-name allocation matches separable documented contributions (concept and first demonstration; accuracy and many-body frontier). The citation should rest on the lattice concept and its realisation, not on the 2005 comb or 2012 ion-control territory, nor on the unfinished redefinition of the second. Magic-angle graphene is a strong second but is young, with an open pairing mechanism and exposed credit (Cao, Dean group, earlier twisted-bilayer theory). The topological insulator trio leaves the 3D branch and the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang proposal outside and overlaps the 2016 prize. An award is preferable to no award.
